Class LoadBalancerKey

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.http.client.loadbalance.LoadBalancerKey
public final class LoadBalancerKey extends Object
The key of a request for the load balancer, e.g. a session or user id: the sticky strategy sends the requests of the same key to the same instance. A request has a key when its attribute is set, or when the service names a header to read it from with micronaut.http.services.<id>.load-balancer-key-header.

    • ATTRIBUTE

      public static final String ATTRIBUTE
      The request attribute that holds the key of the request for the load balancer. Its string form is hashed, so it should be stable, e.g. a String or a Long.
